h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalgaon

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalgaon

items.pText: Jalgaon is the main town of Khandesh, known for its bananas and cotton, with the Ajanta caves a short drive away. At about 330 km from our Vasai factory, it is one of the nearer district towns for FunPlay Systems. We supply playground equipment to schools, housing societies and municipal gardens across Jalgaon district, sent by road and installed on site.

Buyers often ask what actually happens on the day our crew arrives. Knowing in advance helps, so the site and your staff are ready. Our installation team or a local dealer unloads the packed parts, checks them against the order, marks the post positions from the approved layout and begins assembly. Jalgaon's summers are very hot, so an early start is easier on everyone. Water and a power point within reach of the site also save time.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

items: The crew unloads the parts and checks them against the packing list with your representative.
Post positions are marked on the ground from the approved layout drawing.
For grouted pieces, pits are dug and the posts set in concrete. Self-standing pieces are assembled on their base.
The crew checks each piece, and the site is handed over with maintenance notes.

facts.value: About 330 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What do we need to arrange for installation day?
items.a: A cleared site, a person to check the delivery against the packing list, and access to water and power. Keep children and vehicles away from the area while the crew works.

items.q: How soon can children use grouted equipment?
items.a: Only after the concrete foundations have set properly. Our crew will tell you when the equipment is ready, and the area should stay closed off until then. Fencing the area off with tape or barricades is the simplest way to keep children out.

items.q: Do you supply schools across Jalgaon district?
items.a: Yes. Schools, societies and gardens across the district can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.
